proofs.text: Apply the v0.9.5 fixture with `--yes` and verify the gate is `tested`; set the old pre-push setting to the blocking value, apply, and verify the gate is `recorded` with `min_strength` 70 and `ai_review_at` `high`; answer the gate question `approved` and verify the gate is `approved` with `approvers` empty and that a prompt starting `Gate [` was asked; answer `whenever` and verify the gate is `tested`

rule_text: The gate question is asked once more on an update, defaulting to `recorded` when the old pre-push setting was the blocking one and to `tested` otherwise, taking the answer typed when it is one of the three gates and leaving the default when it is not

tests.body:
def test_an_answer_that_is_not_a_gate_leaves_the_default(tmp_path, capsys,
                                                         monkeypatch):
    root = _project(tmp_path, V095)
    _answers(monkeypatch, [('Gate [', 'whenever')])
    _apply(root, argv=())
    capsys.readouterr()
    assert json.loads(_read(root, '.purlin/config.json'))['gate'] == 'tested'
tests.name: test_an_answer_that_is_not_a_gate_leaves_the_default

def test_the_gate_defaults_to_recorded_when_the_hook_was_strict(tmp_path):
    root = _project(tmp_path, V095)
    config = json.loads(_read(root, '.purlin/config.json'))
    config['pre_push'] = 'strict'
    _write(root, '.purlin/config.json', json.dumps(config, indent=2))
    _apply(root)
    written = json.loads(_read(root, '.purlin/config.json'))
    assert written['gate'] == 'recorded'
    assert written['min_strength'] == 70
    assert written['ai_review_at'] == 'high'
tests.name: test_the_gate_defaults_to_recorded_when_the_hook_was_strict

def test_the_gate_question_takes_the_answer_you_type(tmp_path, capsys,
                                                     monkeypatch):
    root = _project(tmp_path, V095)
    asked = _answers(monkeypatch, [('Gate [', 'approved')])
    _apply(root, argv=())
    capsys.readouterr()
    assert any('Gate [' in prompt for prompt in asked)
    written = json.loads(_read(root, '.purlin/config.json'))
    assert written['gate'] == 'approved'
    assert written['approvers'] == []
tests.name: test_the_gate_question_takes_the_answer_you_type
